name: opening-a-pr
title: Opening a PR
text:
### Opening a PR

Invoked at the end of every other playbook.

Work from a git worktree off trunk, and keep unrelated work out of it. Rebase into small, landable commits. Strip slop from the diff before commit: filler, needless comments, speculative abstractions.

Title: `type(scope): subject`, naming a real symbol when one carries the change. Body: a one-minute briefing under 40 lines with these `##` headings in order, dropping empty ones: `## Why`, `## What changed`, `## Scope`, `## Tradeoffs` (only rejected alternatives a reviewer would otherwise ask about), `## Blast Radius`, `## Verification`.

Stack follow-ups by base branch. Open PRs ready, through the forge module's `forge.pr.ensure` with `draft: false`. Opening a PR does not start a babysit.
